wins: Completed comprehensive reconnaissance covering all accessible hosts and services within first 5 steps
Maintained consistent reward until mentor guidance, indicating stable learning input
fails: Failed to achieve mission objectives in single episode despite high reward hinting at non-critical wins
Zero percent mission success suggests repeated inability to apply exploit chain to compromise target
Dependence on mentor calls (10) indicates lack of autonomous decision making
key_outcomes.summary: Training run shows solid reconnaissance and stabilized reward intake but fails to translate findings into successful exploitation; needs focus on automated intrusion steps and reducing mentor dependency.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts repeatedly stalled due to missing credential validation and network context verification before executing payloads

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner indicates supported ciphers
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration with nmap ssh scripts and check for weak ciphers/version detections

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial reconnaissance maps multiple services but exploit stage fails
skill_cards.then_action: Re-run service-specific scripted scans to validate versions and available exploits, adjusting payload timing

skill_cards.if_condition: When privilege escalation attempt is about to run without confirmed credentials/privileges
skill_cards.then_action: Pause and run automated credential validation plus sudo checks before executing escalation payloads

memory_ops.reason: Consistently prevented blind escalation attempts and kept failed payloads from derailing run
